name: Airtable Contacts to Google Sheets
description: Sync recently updated Airtable records into an existing Google Sheet, matching exact Email keys and using RAW values and the A1:E1000 lookup window.
requirements: Airtable connection with read access to the configured base/table and a LastUpdated date field
Google Sheets connection with read/write access to the same spreadsheet on all three sheet actions
An existing first-sheet table in A1:E1000 with contiguous unique headers including Email, at most five columns and no duplicate Email keys in the lookup window
Mapped Airtable cells must be text,numbers,booleans or null; source Email keys must be nonempty unique text
